rows.ja: ストリーム契約の鉱山会社(金属の供給元)
ロイヤルティ・その他の関係
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: アンタミナ銅山のBHP持分の銀について長期ストリーム契約(2026年6月期に締結)
relations.text_en: Long-term silver stream on BHP's share of Antamina, signed in FY2026

source.label: BHP 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: During FY2026, BHP completed a long-term silver streaming agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals International Ltd. relating to BHP's share of silver production from Antamina.

relations.text: カナダのボイジーズベイ鉱山のストリーム契約
relations.text_en: Streaming agreement on Voisey's Bay in Canada

source.label: Vale 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The streaming test, a requirement under the Voisey's Bay streaming agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals Corp and APG Metals Limited, required Voisey's Bay to maintain an average throughput rate of at least 85% of capacity over 90 consecutive days from ore delivered by the underground mines.

relations.text: メキシコのペニャスキート鉱山の銀の25%をWheatonに売る契約
relations.text_en: Sells 25% of Peñasquito silver to Wheaton

source.label: Newmont 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The Company is obligated to sell 25% of silver production from the Peñasquito mine to Wheaton Precious Metals Corporation at the lesser of market price or a fixed contract price, subject to an annual inflation adjustment of up to 1.65%.

companies.name: ハドベイ・ミネラルズ

relations.text: ペルーのコンスタンシア鉱山の銀の全量と金の半分がWheatonとのストリーム契約の対象
relations.text_en: All payable silver and half the payable gold at Constancia go to Wheaton under a stream

source.label: Hudbay 年次情報書(40-F添付、2024年度)
source.label_en: Hudbay annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2024)
source.quote: 100% of the payable silver and 50% of the payable gold at Constancia is subject to a precious metals stream agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals

companies.name: ファースト・マジェスティック

relations.text: メキシコのサンディマス鉱山の生産の25%(金換算)をWheatonが受け取る契約
relations.text_en: Wheaton receives 25% of San Dimas output (gold-equivalent) under a stream

source.label: First Majestic 年次情報書(40-F添付、2024年度)
source.label_en: First Majestic annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2024)
source.quote: First Majestic is party to a purchase (streaming) agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals which entitles Wheaton Precious Metals to receive 25% of the gold equivalent production from the San Dimas mine

relations.text: エクアドルのEl Domo計画の開発資金としてWheatonと貴金属購入契約
relations.text_en: Precious metals purchase agreement with Wheaton to fund the El Domo project

source.label: Silvercorp 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年3月期)
source.label_en: Silvercorp annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY ended Mar 2025)
source.quote: In order to develop the El Domo Project, Adventus entered into a precious metals purchase agreement dated January 17, 2022 (the " PMPA ") with Wheaton Precious Metals International Ltd.

relations.text: ガイアナのToroparu計画の貴金属購入契約
relations.text_en: Precious metals purchase agreement on the Toroparu project

source.label: Aris Mining 年次情報書(40-F、2024年度)
source.label_en: Aris Mining annual information form (40-F, FY2024)
source.quote: The Toroparu PMPA refers to the Amended and Restated Precious Metals Purchase Agreement among Wheaton Precious Metals International Ltd.

companies.name: インテグラ・リソーシズ

relations.text: DeLamar計画のロイヤルティをWheatonと契約(2024年2月)
relations.text_en: Royalty agreement with Wheaton on the DeLamar project (February 2024)

source.label: Integra Resources 年次情報書(40-F添付、2024年度)
source.label_en: Integra Resources annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2024)
source.quote: On February 21, 2024, Integra announced that through its wholly-owned subsidiary, DeLamar Mining Company, it has entered into a binding agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals (Cayman) Co.

relations.text: 豪州Mt Todd計画のロイヤルティ契約(2023年12月)
relations.text_en: Royalty agreement on the Mt Todd project in Australia (December 2023)

source.label: Vista Gold 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2023, Vista entered into a royalty agreement with Wheaton Precious Metals (Cayman) Co., an affiliate of Wheaton Precious Metals Corp., in relation to Mt Todd

relations.text: Wheatonの採掘担当副社長がDenisonの取締役に就任(2025年5月)
relations.text_en: A Wheaton mining vice president joined Denison's board in May 2025

source.label: Denison Mines 年次報告(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Denison Mines annual report (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Wes Carson, Vice President, Mining Operations at Wheaton Precious Metals Corp., was appointed to the Board at the Company's annual and special shareholder meeting held on May 12, 2025.

companies.name: トリプル・フラッグ
companies.sub: ストリーム・ロイヤルティ

relations.text: Triple Flagが、ストリーム・ロイヤルティ金融の主な競合の一社としてWheatonを挙げる
relations.text_en: Triple Flag names Wheaton among its main streaming and royalty competitors

source.label: Triple Flag 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Triple Flag annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: We compete with other providers of streaming and royalty financing, and in particular Franco-Nevada Corporation, Wheaton Precious Metals Corp., Royal Gold, Inc. and OR Royalties Inc., among others.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
